raw_text: Dekho kitne log aaye hain Delhi march mein! Lakho ki bheed hai Singhu border pe. Ye photos aaj subah ki hain. Sarkar ko ab maangi maanni padegi. Kisan ekta zindabad! Share karo sab jagah, duniya ko dikhao hamari taqat.
clean_text: Photos claim to show massive crowds at Singhu border for Delhi farmer march. Account urging wide sharing of images.
